name: mail-rocket
description: Self-hosted email campaigns over AWS SES: the API (apps/api) and the web app (apps/web).

scripts.dev: bun run dev:api & bun run dev:web & wait
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/shared typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && cd apps/web && bunx next typegen && bunx tsc --noEmit -p .
